protocol.calibration: alpha = sum(training Terra) / sum(training S-NPP), refitted using only years before each validation year
protocol.seasonal_baseline: Median Terra count for the same calendar month in preceding training years
protocol.pass_rule: Pooled 48-month ratio MAE must be strictly less than both raw S-NPP and seasonal-baseline MAE
protocol.ranking: Ascending pooled ratio MAE / mean validation Terra count, then ascending county GEOID
protocol.qualification: Existing county polygon, type 0, MODIS confidence >=30, VIIRS confidence n/h, deduplication rules
protocol.later_years: 2020-2025 are excluded from location selection and inspected only after identities are frozen
limitations: This is a selection-based comparison: selected counties have favorable training-period agreement by construction.
Later years are exploratory and are not independent confirmation of a broadly generalizable harmonization method.
Eligibility requires complete reported monthly counts, not verified observation opportunities or cloud-free coverage.
Agreement with Terra counts is not accuracy against wildfire incidents or burned area.
The current Census boundary is applied consistently to all archive years.

source_inventories.subset_scope: Bounding-box candidates; county polygon filtering has not been applied.
source_inventories.coverage_note: Dates of reported detections do not establish valid observation opportunities or cloud-free coverage.
source_inventories.crc_verification: ZipFile checked each entire USA member against its recorded CRC32 while streaming to EOF.
